messages:
nina: Heads-up: PR updating the migration guide has preview failures (link-check + vale). Blocked for merge: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/8602

chris: Can you paste the CI snippet?

ci-bot: docs-preview: PR #8602 failures: link-checker: 2 broken anchors in guides/migrations.md; vale: 1 sentence-case violation. Details: https://ci.redwood-inference/internal/preview/8602

nina: I changed the heading to "Breaking API changes" which changed the slug; other files still link to #api-changes.

chris: Easiest fix is a tiny PR updating the two referring links to the new slug. I'll open `fix/8602-anchors` and tag reviewers.

docs-bot: To rerun preview after patch, comment `@docs-bot rerun-preview` on the PR.

chris: Pushed PR #8603 with the two link edits and a small heading case tweak to satisfy Vale.

ci-bot: docs-preview: rerun queued for PRs #8602 and #8603.

ci-bot: docs-preview: all checks passed for PR #8602 and PR #8603. ✅

nina: Thanks! I'll merge in the 14:00 UTC docs merge window.

chris: Nice, quick turnaround.

docs-bot: Merged and scheduled for docs publish cycle at 16:00 UTC.
